settings.site_tagline: Holiday rental in Mirto Crosia, 800 metres from the Ionian Sea
settings.hero_title: A flowering garden between the Ionian Sea and a Calabria waiting to be discovered
settings.hero_sub: Three rooms with direct-access private bathroom, breakfast included and the sea 800 metres away.
settings.intro_body:
Il giardino di Rosa is a holiday rental in Mirto, a district of Crosia on the Ionian coast of Cosenza. The three rooms have a private bathroom with direct access and air conditioning; breakfast is included and served in the common room, where a fridge, microwave and coffee machine are available to guests.

The sea is 800 metres away: 3 minutes by car or 10–15 on foot. Mirto Crosia is an ideal base to discover the Ionian coast and the Sila National Park: in under an hour and a half by car you can reach castles, villages, museums, gorges and mountains of Calabria. The Odissea 2000 water park is just 10 km away.
settings.seo_title: Il giardino di Rosa · Holiday rental in Mirto Crosia, Ionian Sea (Calabria)

settings.cancellation_policy: Cancellation terms depend on the rate you choose and are shown by Airbnb for your dates before you book. For anything else write to ilgiardinodirosa53@gmail.com.

attractions.name: Amarelli Liquorice Museum
attractions.summary: The Amarelli family's company museum tells five centuries of Calabrian liquorice.

attractions.name: Odissea 2000
attractions.summary: Water and amusement park for days out with children.

attractions.name: Rossano old town
attractions.summary: Byzantine lanes, churches and viewpoints over the Gulf of Corigliano.

attractions.name: Codex Purpureus Rossanensis
attractions.summary: The Diocesan Museum holds the Codex, a 6th-century Greek gospel book on UNESCO's Memory of the World register.

attractions.name: Cariati and its old town
attractions.summary: A seaside village with viewpoints, lanes and wide beaches.

attractions.name: Ducal Castle of Corigliano
attractions.summary: A mighty Norman-Aragonese fortress with frescoed halls and views over plain and gulf.

attractions.name: Sybaris Archaeological Park
attractions.summary: Excavations and museum of the wealthy Achaean colony: three cities layered on the plain.

attractions.name: Santa Maria del Patire Abbey
attractions.summary: Norman-Byzantine abbey with floor mosaics and valley views.

attractions.name: Longobucco and the Sila Greca
attractions.summary: A first taste of the Sila with woods, rivers and traditional weaving.

attractions.name: Cirò Marina
attractions.summary: Capital of Cirò wine: cellars, seafront and the wine museum.

attractions.name: Sibaritide Thermal Baths
attractions.summary: Sulphurous thermal waters for a day of wellbeing.

attractions.name: Roseto Capo Spulico Castle
attractions.summary: A Frederician castle perched over the sea, one of Calabria's most scenic.

attractions.name: Lake Cecita
attractions.summary: A large lake among Sila pines: walks, picnics and silence.

attractions.name: Altomonte
attractions.summary: One of Italy's most beautiful villages, with Santa Maria della Consolazione church.

attractions.name: Camigliatello Silano
attractions.summary: Heart of the Sila: pine forests, mushrooms, cheeses and cool walks.

attractions.name: Crotone museums
attractions.summary: National Archaeological Museum with the treasure of Hera Lacinia and Charles V Castle.

attractions.name: Rocca Imperiale Castle
attractions.summary: A majestic Swabian castle near the Basilicata border, among lemon groves and a white village.

attractions.name: Raganello Gorges
attractions.summary: A spectacular Pollino canyon with canyoning, trekking and the Devil's Bridge.

attractions.name: Le Castella
attractions.summary: The Aragonese fortress on the sea: the longest trip (about 1h45), best kept for a full day.

faqs.a: The sea is about 800 metres away: 3 minutes by car or 10–15 minutes on foot. The Mirto seafront has wide free beaches with showers and free parking.
Bookings are made on Airbnb: the «Book on Airbnb» button shows availability, prices and cancellation terms for your dates. For questions you can write or call us.
Yes, every morning from 8 to 10 am in the common room, which also has a fridge, microwave and coffee machine. If you have allergies or dietary needs, let us know.

faqs.q: Does every room have a private bathroom?
faqs.a: Yes, all three rooms have a double bed, a private bathroom with direct access from the room, and air conditioning.
Yes, street parking near the property is free.
No: as this is a holiday rental, daily cleaning is not provided. Towels are changed every 3 days and linen every 7; in the common room you will find what you need for any cleaning.

faqs.q: What can I visit in a day trip?
faqs.a: Rossano, Corigliano, Sybaris, the Sila, the Pollino and more within an hour and a half by car: see the “Explore” section. The Odissea 2000 water park is 10 km away.

rules.text: Check-in after 2 pm. Check-out by 10 am so the room can be cleaned.
Guests follow the property's rules and the manager's instructions.
Guests are responsible for the safety of their children at all times.
When you go out, close windows and doors to prevent rain damage and keep the property safe.
Switch off lights, air conditioning and appliances when not in use: it helps the environment.
Smoking is not allowed inside the property.
Breakfast is served every morning from 8 to 10 am. Please tell us about any allergies on arrival.
Please report any damage or breakage immediately. Do not move furniture or objects between rooms.
Door-to-door sorted waste collection: use the bins provided; we empty the room bins.
As this is a holiday rental, daily cleaning is not provided: towels are changed every 3 days and bed linen every 7. In the common room you will find what you need for any cleaning.
For emergencies or special needs: Francesca, +39 338 68 92 300.

reviews.author: Marco
reviews.text: It really felt like being at home. Francesco and Francesca embody all the warmth and hospitality of Calabrian people. Great attention to guests. The place is spotless, tidy and has everything you need. Air conditioning in the rooms and in the common area too. […] Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Elisa
reviews.text: The room was extremely clean and tidy, as was the common area. Breakfast was provided every morning. The host was available and responsive whenever we needed him. The property is a short distance from the sea and the main road, an excellent location. If we return to Mirto we will definitely stay at Il Giardino di Rosa!

reviews.author: Antea
reviews.text: Francesco's place stands out for its cleanliness and attention to guests. Comfortable spaces, satisfying breakfast. A short walk from the sea, a refuge with every comfort in a very quiet part of Mirto. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Francesco
reviews.text: A wonderful, small and lovely place. Everything perfectly clean and anything you may need is provided. An amazing host, very quick to answer every message, and the area is very quiet and peaceful. I will definitely come back!

reviews.author: Pierre
reviews.text: Without taking the car: an excellent pastry shop 250 m away and beach access in under 10 minutes on foot. I highly recommend this place.

reviews.author: Charlie
reviews.text: I missed a connection because of a train delay, and Francesco and Francesca offered to pick me up in the middle of the night, 35 minutes away. Extremely helpful and kind, they knew the area well. No complaints at all.

reviews.author: Emanuele
reviews.text: Tidy, very clean and welcoming. Very helpful and precise host. Quiet area very close to the sea. We will be back!

reviews.author: Rodolphe
reviews.text: Francesca and Francesco are very friendly and helpful. The whole apartment and the room were new and very clean.

reviews.author: Anne
reviews.text: Great welcome, quiet and well-thought-out place, very friendly hosts who organise themselves so as not to disturb during breakfast preparation. If we are back in the area we will return.

reviews.author: Maurizio
reviews.text: This host and his wife are so kind and friendly they make you feel at home! A 100% insider tip for a trip to Calabria.

reviews.author: Simonluca
reviews.text: Very kind hosts, spotless accommodation and common areas. I received great tips to make the most of my stay and visit the surroundings.

reviews.author: Mario
reviews.text: Air conditioning, great attention to detail such as the map of Calabria with places of interest within a few hours' drive, and leaflets on local restaurants. Very helpful host, also for requests such as changing check-in time.
